Answer: PP Nomor 16 Tahun 2021 is a government regulation concerning the implementation of Law Number 28 of 2002 on Buildings and Structures. It was established on February 2, 2021, in Jakarta, and it has a status of being in effect. This regulation aims to standardize the implementation of the law and includes provisions on the classification, technical standards, and management of building constructions. It also mentions the roles of various stakeholders involved in the construction and management of buildings, including government agencies and private sector players.
